content_decisions: The artwork clearly distinguishes the 400 mg two-tablet serving from the 200 mg amount per tablet.
The original UAE price shown in the artwork is AED 89.25, not the current offer price.
Retailer identity and the offer price are omitted from the artwork and caption.
The verdict is conditional because the labeled 400 mg supplemental dose exceeds the NIH adult supplemental upper limit of 350 mg without clinical supervision.
No disease-treatment, deficiency-diagnosis or unsupported superiority claim is made.
